name: camera
style: A 1970s Super 8 home movie: warm faded colours, soft focus, heavy film grain, light leaks and flares at the frame edges, slight gate weave, golden summer light.
picture_style: Style: a frame from a 1970s Super 8 home movie, warm faded colours, soft focus, heavy grain, orange light leaks at the edges.
voice: A young woman with a soft, smiling, nostalgic voice

girl.draw: A young woman of about twenty on a sunny wooden pier by the sea in summer, seen from the waist up, laughing, holding a boxy cream-coloured instant camera with a single teal stripe in both hands at chest height. Long wavy auburn hair, a white cotton sundress, freckles, a woven bracelet.
girl.is: the young woman with long wavy auburn hair, freckles and a white cotton sundress

cam.draw: One boxy cream-coloured instant film camera with a single teal stripe across its front, a large round lens, a small square flash and a wide slot at the bottom front where photos come out, sitting on weathered wooden pier boards in summer sunlight, sea sparkling out of focus behind.
cam.is: the boxy cream-coloured instant camera with a single teal stripe, a large round lens and a photo slot at the front

table.draw: Seen from directly above: a worn wooden table in warm evening light covered with a loose scatter of white-bordered square instant photographs of summer moments (friends jumping off a pier, a campfire, a wet dog, a sunset), with the boxy cream-coloured instant camera with a teal stripe lying among them and one empty space in the middle of the table.
table.is: the wooden table seen from above, scattered with white-bordered instant photos, with the cream instant camera lying among them

clips.sound: Waves under a wooden pier, gulls, laughter, a mechanical shutter click and the whirr of a photo sliding out.

shots.text: On a sunny wooden pier {girl} lifts a boxy cream instant camera to her eye, grinning, hair blowing across her face, the sea glittering behind her.
three friends in swimsuits running down the pier away from the camera and leaping off the end together, arms and legs flung wide against the bright sky, a burst of spray rising.
a close-up of {cam} as a square white-bordered photograph slides smoothly out of the front slot, its grey surface slowly developing into a picture of three friends in mid-air over the sea.

clips.sound: A crackling campfire at dusk, soft guitar strumming far off, a dog shaking itself, wind on a string of paper.

shots.text: At dusk on the beach {girl} sits by a campfire wrapped in a blanket, laughing with her head thrown back, sparks rising, friends as warm blurred shapes around her.
a shaggy golden dog standing at the water's edge shaking itself dry in slow motion, a halo of droplets catching the low orange sun.
a row of white-bordered square instant photographs clipped to a string with wooden clothespins, fluttering gently in the evening wind in front of a glowing orange sunset over the sea.

clips.sound: A quiet room, a clock, the soft slide of a photograph on wood, one shutter click.

shots.text: {table}, the camera slowly lowering toward the empty space in the middle of the photographs.

{girl} on the pier smiling straight into the lens, alive and moving, while a white border closes in around her from all four sides until she is a square instant photograph, still gently moving inside its frame.
the finished white-bordered photograph of the smiling young woman lying in the middle of the wooden table among the other photos, with {cam} resting beside it in the warm evening light.
